statement.p: The maintenance department at the main campus of a large state university receives daily requests to replace fluorecent lightbulbs. The distribution of the number of daily requests is bell-shaped and has a mean of 43 and a standard deviation of 8.
Using the 68-95-99.7 rule, what is the approximate percentage of lightbulb replacement requests numbering between 27 and 43?

p.em: (Type answer as a percent, do not enter the percent symbol)
